summary: Frontend-only test of Focus Buddy renderer at /index.html. All 12 test cases from the review pass. Timer default (25:00), presets (10/25/45/60), custom duration clamp (37, 500->180, 0/-5 -> 01:00), start (button->Pause, countdown works, cat class changes to state-sit/etc.), state alternation (sampled state-idle and state-sit over ~14s during a 2-min run), pause (countdown halts, bubble 'Taking a tiny break', button->Resume, cat idle), reset (clock restores to 02:00, bubble 'Ready when you are!'), full end-to-end 1-min session (waited ~60s -> celebration bubble 'Study session complete! 🎉 You studied for 1 minutes!', cat state-celebrate then idle, clock restored to 01:00, streak-count 0->1), bubble close hides speech bubble, coat wardrobe adds app-coat-black / app-coat-orange and toggles active swatch, sound-toggle toggles 'on' class. Compact dark panel + visible pixel cat confirmed (screenshot). NO app-originated console errors — the only console errors are CSP violations for a Cloudflare beacon inline script injected by the preview edge, which is infrastructure noise unrelated to Focus Buddy code.

issues: Grammar: says 'You studied for 1 minutes!' (should be '1 minute' for singular). window.FB_SAY.doneFmt in interactions.js hardcodes the plural.

action_items: OPTIONAL/minor: fix pluralization in FB_SAY.doneFmt so 1-minute sessions render 'You studied for 1 minute!' instead of '1 minutes!'.

INFRA (not app bug): Cloudflare beacon inline script is injected by the preview proxy and blocked by the app's CSP (script-src 'self'). App is unaffected but console shows 2 CSP errors on every load. If a clean console is desired in preview, either loosen CSP or exclude beacon injection; recommend leaving CSP strict since the desktop Electron target is what ships.
critical_code_review_comments: app.js: chip.disabled is set for buttons — good. customInput.disabled correctly toggled during study — good.
timer.js setMinutes clamps 1..180 with Math.round — correctly handles 0, negative, and 500.
Session flow correctly re-enables controls on finish and calls timer.reset() ~3.8s after celebrate, so clock returns to the chosen duration (verified 01:00 after 1-min run).
Streak persistence uses per-date key with localStorage — verified increments and reads back.
Minor UX: doneFmt should use singular for 1 minute.
prompts._show can display action-bearing bubbles that never autohide (autoHideMs: 0). During short sessions the prompt stays until finish — acceptable but user has to close manually.
seed_data_creation: localStorage cleared at test start to reset streak/coat/sound to defaults.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Renderer is served statically at https://pomo-pal.preview.emergentagent.com/index.html (React frontend service intentionally stopped). Test with localStorage.clear() before streak assertions. Console will contain 2 CSP-blocked-inline-script errors caused by Cloudflare beacon injection at the edge — ignore these; they're not from Focus Buddy code. Full 1-minute end-to-end takes ~65s; poll bubble text for 'complete' to short-circuit.
rca of the issue: N/A — no functional defects. The only minor cosmetic issue is 'You studied for 1 minutes!' grammar in interactions.js FB_SAY.doneFmt.
